title: Smoke-test Fabro-managed clone and branch metadata

goal.value: Smoke-test Fabro-managed clone and branch metadata

script.String:
set -eu
mkdir -p .fabro/tmp
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > .fabro/tmp/clone-smoke.txt
git add .fabro/tmp/clone-smoke.txt
git config user.email fabro@example.invalid
git config user.name Fabro
git commit -m 'Smoke-test Fabro managed clone commit'
git log -1 --format='%h %s'
git status --short

set -eu
echo PWD=$PWD
echo '--- branch ---'
git branch --show-current || true
echo '--- HEAD ---'
git log -1 --format='%h %s'
echo '--- status ---'
git status --short
echo '--- refs containing HEAD ---'
git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' --contains HEAD refs/heads refs/remotes || true

set -eu
echo PWD=$PWD
echo HOME=${HOME:-}
echo '--- git root ---'
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
echo '--- branch ---'
git branch --show-current || true
echo '--- HEAD ---'
git log -1 --format='%h %s'
echo '--- remotes ---'
git remote -v
echo '--- status ---'
git status --short
echo '--- refs containing HEAD ---'
git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' --contains HEAD refs/heads refs/remotes || true

spec.graph_source:
digraph CloneSmoke {
  graph [goal="Smoke-test Fabro-managed clone and branch metadata"]
  rankdir=LR

  start [shape=Mdiamond, label="Start"]
  exit [shape=Msquare, label="Exit"]

  inspect_checkout [
    label="Inspect Fabro-managed checkout",
    shape=parallelogram,
    script="set -eu
echo PWD=$PWD
echo HOME=${HOME:-}
echo '--- git root ---'
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
echo '--- branch ---'
git branch --show-current || true
echo '--- HEAD ---'
git log -1 --format='%h %s'
echo '--- remotes ---'
git remote -v
echo '--- status ---'
git status --short
echo '--- refs containing HEAD ---'
git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' --contains HEAD refs/heads refs/remotes || true"
  ]

  make_commit [
    label="Make sandbox-only commit",
    shape=parallelogram,
    script="set -eu
mkdir -p .fabro/tmp
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > .fabro/tmp/clone-smoke.txt
git add .fabro/tmp/clone-smoke.txt
git config user.email fabro@example.invalid
git config user.name Fabro
git commit -m 'Smoke-test Fabro managed clone commit'
git log -1 --format='%h %s'
git status --short"
  ]

  inspect_after_commit [
    label="Inspect after commit",
    shape=parallelogram,
    script="set -eu
echo PWD=$PWD
echo '--- branch ---'
git branch --show-current || true
echo '--- HEAD ---'
git log -1 --format='%h %s'
echo '--- status ---'
git status --short
echo '--- refs containing HEAD ---'
git for-each-ref --format='%(refname:short)' --contains HEAD refs/heads refs/remotes || true"
  ]

  start -> inspect_checkout
  inspect_checkout -> make_commit
  make_commit -> inspect_after_commit
  inspect_after_commit -> exit
}
